The Textile Side of the Loss

The Structure Is Only Part of the Loss.

After fire, smoke, soot, water, flood, or another property loss, the things inside matter too.

Clothing.Linens.Fabrics.Personal belongings.

Some carry financial value. Others carry meaning that cannot simply be replaced. American Clothing Restoration focuses on professional care for affected clothing and textiles.

Because What Can Be Restored Deserves the Chance to Be Restored.

Our Specialty

Property restoration requires many different areas of expertise.

American Clothing Restoration focuses on ours.

What We Restore

Textiles Deserve More Than a Generic Answer.

Clothing & Garments

Professional care for affected everyday clothing, professional attire, and other garments.

Household Textiles

Care for recoverable fabric-based household belongings affected by a property loss.

Bedding & Linens

Professional textile care for household linens where restoration is practical.

Drapery & Window Textiles

Fabric window treatments may be considered depending on material and condition.

Specialty Garments

Certain formal and specialty garments may require more detailed handling and finishing.

Loss Types

Different Damage. Different Decisions.

Fire & Smoke

Smoke and soot can travel well beyond the source of a fire and settle into fabrics and clothing.

Water & Flood

Water can affect fibers, dyes, finishes, shape, appearance, and odor.

Soot & Residue

Visible contamination is only part of the problem. Affected textiles require careful evaluation.

Our Process

Care at Every Stage.

01

Assess

Restoration begins with understanding what happened and evaluating the affected textiles.

02

Sort

Items are organized so appropriate cleaning and handling methods can be selected.

03

Clean

Professional cleaning methods address the condition of the item while respecting its material.

04

Restore

The objective is to return affected textiles as close as reasonably possible to their pre-loss condition.

05

Finish

Cleaning is followed by careful finishing and preparation.

06

Return

Restored clothing and textiles are prepared for return.

Damage Changes Things.
Restoration Can Change Them Again.

About American Clothing Restoration

A Specialist Has One Job: Know the Work.

American Clothing Restoration is based in Ephrata, Pennsylvania and specializes in professional garment cleaning and textile restoration associated with fire, flood, water, and property damage.

Our work sits at the intersection of garment care and property restoration. That specialization matters.

Clothing.
Textiles.
Restoration.

Can It Be Saved? When the answer is yes, that is where restoration begins.

Our Approach

Restore First.

Replacement has its place. So does restoration. When a textile can reasonably be cleaned, restored, and returned, preserving the original item may make more sense than automatically replacing it.

No exaggerated promises. No one-size-fits-all answer. Just focused textile care aimed at achieving the best reasonable result for the item in front of us.

American Clothing Restoration

Some Things Can Be Replaced.
And Some Things Deserve to Be Restored.
